cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaTotal: Everything you are owed today: the balance of orders that are not fully paid yet, not counting voided or cancelled ones. Click to clear the risk and age filters.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaVencida: Balance of orders that are past their payment due date (delivery date plus the customer's payment term), from the first day late. The part over 15 days is shown below. Click to show only customers with overdue receivables.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaDias: Average days outstanding: how many days orders with a balance have been open, counted from the delivery date (or the creation date if there is no delivery) and weighted by the amount owed. Formula: sum of (balance × days) ÷ sum of balances. It is not the financial DSO. Click to sort by the most overdue customer.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaExcede: Customers whose debt has already passed the credit limit you assigned. It only counts customers with a credit limit set. Click to show those customers.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaDiasCliente: This customer's average days outstanding: how many days their orders with a balance have been open since delivery, weighted by the amount owed (sum of balance × days ÷ sum of balances). These are not their days overdue.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaRiesgo: Cash and Credit are decided by the customer's credit limit: a limit above 0 means Credit; a limit of 0 or none set means Cash, even if the customer has a payment term.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaPorVencer: Balance of orders that are not overdue yet but whose payment deadline falls in the next 7 days (today included). Use it to collect before they become overdue. It is not added to overdue receivables. Click to show only the customers with payments coming due.
cartera.carteraClientes.ayudaSinCupo: No customer has a credit limit. Once you assign limits, you will see here how many go over. The limit is set when editing each customer in the customer list.
cartera.carteraVendedores.subtitulo: Who holds the receivables and how much is overdue.
cartera.carteraVendedores.resumen: {{n}} sellers · {{vencida}} overdue. Tap to see the details.
cartera.carteraVendedores.ayuda: Each customer counts for the salesperson on their order. Overdue balance is the balance of orders 1 or more days late. The overdue percentage is the overdue part of what that salesperson is owed. Clicking a salesperson adds their customers to the filter of the list below; another click removes it. You can pick several.
cartera.carteraVendedores.filtrar: Filter the list by this salesperson
cartera.carteraEvolucion.subtitulo: Total and overdue receivables over the last 12 months.
cartera.carteraEvolucion.ayuda: Each month shows the latest snapshot of that month. The current month is shown as of today. Lighter bars are months estimated backwards from today's orders and payments: they are a reference, not an exact figure.
cartera.carteraEvolucion.mejora: Improved {{pts}} points versus the previous month.
cartera.carteraEvolucion.empeora: Worsened {{pts}} points versus the previous month.
cartera.carteraAging.ayudaTotal: Everything you are owed today: orders with an outstanding balance.
cartera.carteraAging.ayudaRango: What you are owed on orders in the “{{rango}}” range, counted from each order's payment due date.

tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaRecaudadoHoy:
Payments approved today (Colombia time), across all payment methods.
Counts the day Treasury approved the payment, not the day it was uploaded.
Does not include payments under review, rejected or voided.
tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaCarteraPendi:
Orders that still have money to collect: payment status Pending, To review or Pre-approved (partial payment). Takes all orders, of any date, and adds up what is still unpaid.
Does not count voided, cancelled, returned or rejected orders.
That is why it is usually higher than «Unpaid»: it includes those that are To review and those from more than a year ago.
tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaPorRevisar: Payment receipts that someone uploaded and that Treasury has not yet approved or rejected. Of any date and regardless of the order status. The value is the sum of those receipts.
tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaSinPago:
Orders from the last year with payment status Pending or Pre-approved (nothing paid or partly paid). It is the same number as in the «Unpaid» list.
Does not include those that are To review or those from more than a year ago, which is why it is lower than «Pending receivables».
tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaAlertasActiv: Notices of repeated receipts that you have not resolved yet, from all dates. The same receipt number used in several orders generates several notices; in the Alerts tab they are grouped by number.
tesoreria.gestionPagos.ayudaRechazados: Orders whose payment status is Rejected, of any date. Orders are counted, not receipts.
